description: This file defines an Angular standalone component called RecipeCardComponent, which represents a UI component for displaying a recipe card. It imports necessary modules, declares inputs, injects a RecipeService, and includes methods for calculating total time and toggling favorite status.

classes.name: RecipeCardComponent
classes.description: An Angular component displaying a recipe card, with functionalities to show total preparation and cooking time and toggle favorite status.

methods.name: totalTime
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total time for a given recipe by adding preparation and cooking times.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Prevents default event behavior and stops propagation, then calls the RecipeService to toggle the favorite status of the recipe by its ID.
